aggregation: fitting seeds averaged within outer fold, then outer-fold mean and SD; within-fold seed SD reported separately
dataset_loading: newdata.load_newdata (every OpenML pin: identity, shape, missing and infinite cells, labels, class counts, sha256 of X, y and feature names, harness fingerprint); the loaded arrays must equal the batch run's prepared data.npz, and its dataset and splits hashes must equal newdata.PINS; the prepared data are copied from the batch run
decision_rule: freeze only if the calibrated projection at 16 single-thread workers is at most 3 h: the simulated first-free-worker makespan of the planned jobs in planned order, each job priced at the batch run's realized outer fit and predict seconds of its fold and seeds times the piloted all-variants/views7 time ratio (the pilot dataset of the same no_augment fit source; the largest piloted ratio otherwise)

depth_split.definition: per dataset, untrained minus views7 accuracy (fitting seeds averaged within fold), grouped by the hidden widths of the reconstructed selection; per group the folds, n, mean, SD, min, max and the corrected resampled t interval over the group's folds when n >= 2; pooled across datasets per group: n, mean and SD

failure_policy: log_all_failures; a failed variant fit leaves an explicit failed row; failed jobs are never omitted from the summary; no adaptive stopping on any score; a views7 reproduction failure is an integrity failure: its job fails, the pending jobs are cancelled and the summary refuses
fit_reuse: views7 is fitted once per seed and fold; views1 and views3 are majorities over its first one and three per-view kNN votes (view v depends only on derive_seed(seed, "view", v)); prototype_readout is the majority of the output rule of the same seven trained networks; no_checkpoint and no_augment are fitted separately unless their parameters coincide with views7 (no_augment where the resolved augment is already false), in which case the record says identical_to_views7; untrained and input_knn are fitted separately and train nothing; reused fits carry zero timings and name their source fit

knn_readout.selection: mean accuracy over StratifiedKFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=derive_seed(view_seed, "readout_selection")) splits of the training partition inside every fit; fewer splits only if the smallest class has fewer rows; one neighbour cache per split at the largest k; ties lowest_canonical_config_id; refit on the full training representation
knn_readout.source: identical to arrowflow_full_knn (newdata_batch1.json and newdata_batch2.json models.arrowflow_full_knn.readout)

parallelism: spawned single-thread process per dataset and outer fold under the shared execution lock

variant_definitions.input_knn: the same seven encoders with the kNN readout tuned on the encoded input positions (knn_controls.MultiViewInputKNN)
variant_definitions.no_augment: augment false; kNN readout; identical_to_views7 where the resolved augment is already false
variant_definitions.no_checkpoint: validation_ratio 0: networks trained on all training rows without the validation checkpoint; kNN readout
variant_definitions.prototype_readout: the output rule of the same seven trained networks (ArrowFlowEstimator.predict_orders per view), majority vote; derived from the views7 fit without retraining
variant_definitions.untrained: the selected widths, embed_dim, degree and seeds with every network at its seeded initial filters and the same kNN readout selection (knn_controls.UntrainedMultiViewArrowFlowKNN)
variant_definitions.views1: n_views 1: the first per-view kNN vote of views7 (what MultiViewArrowFlowKNN with n_views 1 predicts)
variant_definitions.views3: n_views 3: the majority of the first three per-view kNN votes of views7
variant_definitions.views7: ArrowFlow-kNN (MultiViewArrowFlowKNN, seven views) at the reconstructed selection; must reproduce the reference outer predictions exactly
